description: This file contains JavaScript code for interacting with a backend API in a frontend application. It includes functions to resolve the API base URL, fetch JSON data from various endpoints, and provide module overview and metrics data for a dashboard.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL with optional credentials, handling errors and content types.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if necessary.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the dashboard overview, including total users and deployed applications.
